note: The public summary of where this tool is going. The working document is dilas-roadmap.md in the repo root, which carries the reasoning, the dependency chain and the open questions. This file is the short version for the person using the tool, so keep every entry to one sentence and update it when the working document moves.

solo.label: Needs nothing new
solo.note: Runs in your browser with no account, no server and no network call.

social.label: Needs the server
social.note: Passes something between browsers or keeps it somewhere other than yours, so it waits on the server rather than running in this tab.

milestones.title: The tool itself
milestones.say: Tier lists for all six slots, your collection, the loadout builder and Drop Bay. Everything kept in this browser.

milestones.title: Eleven themes
milestones.say: Three base skins and eight warbond ones, each with its own atmosphere behind the panels.

milestones.title: A second opinion, for where you are dropping
milestones.say: Say the front, planet and mission and every row gets a second rating next to the community vote, with a sentence for every point of difference.

milestones.title: Enemy armour
milestones.say: What your penetration actually opens on this front, and what it bounces off, measured against every body part of all 80 enemies.

milestones.title: Difficulty
milestones.say: Ratings judged against the enemies you can meet at the level you play at, rather than everything the front can field.

milestones.title: The last judgement calls
milestones.say: A handful of things no source records, like which support weapons are the ones you aim at something far away, currently named by hand and admitted to.

milestones.title: Scoring a whole build
milestones.say: Every build now carries two readings, what its gear is worth where you are dropping and what the nine pieces are worth together, which is where armour penetration finally means something: the question was never whether your rifle opens a Hulk, it is whether anything you brought does.

milestones.title: Drop Bay becomes the drop screen
milestones.say: The moment before you dive: the mission brief, a slot for each of your squad, your loadout confirmed in yours, and what is going to hurt.

milestones.title: Live party
milestones.say: Open a party, read its code out, and your squadmates' confirmed loadouts land in their slots as they commit, with no account needed.

milestones.title: The galaxy map
milestones.say: Set where you are dropping in the war room: the galaxy map across the screen, coloured with the live war, with the Major Order, the war so far and what each difficulty brings laid over it.

milestones.title: The Star Map
milestones.say: The galaxy map as its own place for reading the war: every front, each planet's intel and how it has moved hour by hour, and one click to drop there.

milestones.title: Drop Bay is the front door
milestones.say: The tool opens on Drop Bay, suggests from your own builds for where you are going, and lets you adjust one without leaving, with the tier list as the picker inside every build.

milestones.title: The Armoury
milestones.say: Your builds kept and named, and a coverage view that shows what you have for each occasion on each front, and where the gaps are.

milestones.title: The rules, out in the open
milestones.say: Every rule behind our rating, what it moves where you are dropping, and a switch to turn any of it off and see what changes.

milestones.title: Commando missions
milestones.say: Automaton Commando missions read the way they play: twelve reinforcements, every call-in twice at most, and weapons that need no ammo near the top.

milestones.title: Share a build
milestones.say: A link that carries the build itself, so a friend can keep a copy without either of you needing an account.

milestones.title: Try this for a change
milestones.say: Once you have a few drops logged, Drop Bay suggests a build you have not taken in a while, and gear that is good here that you have never brought against that front.

milestones.title: Planet effects in the ratings
milestones.say: The strains, surges and other live effects on a planet changing what the tool tells you to bring.

milestones.title: Accounts
milestones.say: Log in somewhere else and your collection is there. Opens once password reset can send mail from dilas.me, because a forgotten password needs an email to come back from.

milestones.title: Friends and finding a group
milestones.say: A friends list, so a party invite comes from your list instead of a code, and an LFG board. Arrives with accounts.

milestones.title: Exchange
milestones.say: Browse other people's builds, and keep the ones worth keeping.
